name: io.github.ranklancer/pihole-mcp
title: Pi-hole MCP Server
description: MCP server for Pi-hole v6 API — multi-instance DNS ad-blocker management. Query logs, allow/deny lists, group management, gravity reload, and stats across multiple Pi-hole instances.

environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_INSTANCES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of Pi-hole instance names (e.g. 'pihole' or 'primary,secondary')

environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your first Pi-hole instance (e.g. 'http://192.168.1.100')

environmentVariables.name: PIHOLE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: API password for your first Pi-hole instance
